name: Hilton Vallarta Riviera All Inclusive Resort

address.street: Carr Barra de Navidad km 4.5 Zona Hotelera Puerto Vallarta

insider_take: This beachfront paradise sits where the Sierra Madre Mountains dramatically meet Banderas Bay, creating one of Mexico's most stunning natural amphitheaters.
whats_special: The resort occupies prime real estate on Riviera Nayarit's golden coastline, just minutes from Puerto Vallarta's charming cobblestone streets and iconic church tower. The property features multiple infinity pools that seem to blend seamlessly with the Pacific horizon, while the nearby Malecón boardwalk offers world-class dining and vibrant nightlife within easy reach.
pro_tip: Book dinner reservations early for the resort's oceanfront restaurants – the sunset views during golden hour are absolutely magical, and tables fill up quickly during peak season.
dont_miss: Take the short trip to downtown Puerto Vallarta to experience the famous Los Arcos rock formations – perfect for snorkeling and photography. The resort's location also provides easy access to hidden beaches like Playa Las Animas, accessible only by boat and known for its crystal-clear waters and authentic beachside palapas.
pros: Premium all-inclusive experience with unlimited dining and drinks
Adults-only sophisticated atmosphere perfect for couples
Stunning beachfront location on Riviera Nayarit
Multiple specialty restaurants and premium bars
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
Higher price point compared to standard all-inclusive resorts
